title: Now Hiring: One Robot
preview: This week: an AI rollout with no staff, and a clinic that values your feedback in writing.

jokes.setup: The hospital announced an AI assistant to ease the nursing shortage.
jokes.punchline: It can chart, triage and schedule, but it still can't be in two rooms at once, so it has been promoted to administration.

jokes.setup: The clinic sent a survey asking how satisfied I was with my 40-minute wait.
jokes.punchline: The survey takes 45 minutes, so they're really committed to consistency.

cartoon.caption: “It never sleeps, never complains, and never asks for a raise. Unlike the two of you.”
cartoon.alt: A smiling executive presents a large robot to a tired doctor and nurse while patients wait on gurneys behind them.
